title: Restatement § 81 — consideration and motive
summary: The presence of other motives does not alone defeat a bargained-for exchange.
notes: Use the chapter’s discussion to separate motive, knowledge, and the performance sought in exchange. The complete assigned SEL text and comments have not been supplied.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 58–61. Open assigned page 58.
